bugs_found: apply_fee clamps fee above fee_max to fee_min instead of fee_max, silently undercharging large fees
transfer is non-atomic: source balance is debited before destination credit, so a failure during credit can lose funds
transfer has no concurrency control; concurrent transfers can race and overdraw or lose balance updates
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as finite Decimal, causing type errors or precision/type inconsistency versus other money functions
compound_interest accepts negative principal, enabling nonsensical negative balances/returns
